fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly's (LLY) investigational drug EloraTZP showed average weight loss of 54.1 pounds at 48 weeks in phase 2 trials; 2026 shares rose 25%, outperforming the healthcare sector average of 19%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Lilly captures approximately 61% of the US weight-loss drug market, significantly ahead of Novo, and while net losses are primarily non-cash in nature (paper losses), the company's fundamentals remain solid.
